answer: A pearl of trust grows only under guardians: each identity holds a ferrous bond locked in escrow and rotates its key only after k-of-n staked guardians co-sign plus a public 24-hour delay. A gale of random spot-checks asks guardians to re-attest liveness; a guardian who vouches for a fake loses its own bond. Forging one identity is cheap, but forging a whole guardian quorum per fake, each with its own locked bond and history, costs more than the identity can ever earn.
